title: AI Frameworks Engineer - Intern
description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
Join Intel's AI Frameworks team in Guadalajara, Mexico as an intern and help optimize AI workloads using PyTorch Framework for current and next-generation Intel Xeon platforms.
You will work alongside experienced engineers on real-world AI performance and framework projects, contributing to PyTorch and its ecosystem while gaining hands-on experience with machine learning framework internals, model optimization, software performance analysis, and platform enablement.
Your work will help improve the experience and performance of AI applications used by developers and customers worldwide.
Business Group
As part of the Data Center Group (DCG), the PyTorch and AI Frameworks Ecosystem team focuses on developing cutting-edge solutions for artificial intelligence applications. This team is dedicated to enabling advancements in AI frameworks, tools, and systems that power the next generation of data center technologies and products.
Through collaboration, innovation, and a passion for technology, DCG supports Intel's broader mission to drive progress in high-performance computing and AI-powered solutions.
Responsibilities will include but are not limited to:
Supporting the enablement, profiling, debugging, and optimization of AI workloads and models running on Intel server platforms.
Contributing to PyTorch and ecosystem libraries, helping improve functionality, performance, and out-of-box experience on Intel hardware.
Investigating and resolving build, test, and runtime issues across Linux and Windows environments for specific AI models.
Collaborating with engineers across Intel and with the open-source community through GitHub issues, code reviews, and upstream contributions.
Documenting technical findings and contributing to team knowledge sharing.
The ideal candidate should show the following behavioral traits:
Strong analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Advanced English communication skills.
Willingness to learn about new technologies.
Effective communication and collaboration skills in multidisciplinary environments.
Qualifications:
Minimum qualifications are required to be initially considered for this position .
Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field (at least 1 year remaining as active student).
6+ months of experience in:
programming languages such as Python and C++.
PyTorch Framework.
Machine learning and deep learning concepts, algorithms, and methodologies.
Git and collaborative software development practices.
AI-assisted software development tools, including agentic AI solutions (such as Github Copilot, Claude Code).
Intermediate to advanced English level.
Requirements listed would be obtained through a combination of relevant industry job experience, internship experience, and/or schoolwork/classes/research.
Must have unrestricted, permanent right to work in Mexico (this role is not eligible for visa or immigration sponsorship).
Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.
Relevant experience in working with optimization techniques and performance tuning for AI models.
Familiarity with hardware-software integration in AI systems.
Knowledge of Git and collaborative software development practices
Join us in shaping the future of AI and make a meaningful impact through your work. Take the next step in your career with Intel, where innovation and growth are key.
A candidate who accepts an offer of employment in Mexico is required to present their own personal identification information and numbers for the following: Mexican Security Number (NSS), Tax Identification Number (RFC) and CURP identification number.

Student / Intern
